verdict.rationale: Groq's models docs list OpenAI's open-weight GPT-OSS 120B on its OpenAI-compatible serverless API. Community reports show Mixtral, Llama 2 70B and Kimi K2 served there, and the docs refer to multiple models ("Flex processing is available for all models"), so a multi-family open-weight catalog exists. Breadth and currency are thin: Llama and Mixtral evidence comes from older community posts, and one user reports newer models moved to 'call us for quotes'. missing for 10: documented current Llama, Qwen and DeepSeek availability, a first-party full catalog listing, confirmation that new models are on shared serverless endpoints rather than quote-only.
